GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced keenly in the early stages when being restrained by its rider. Raced wide without cover throughout. Rider explained he had been instructed to attempt to ride his mount with cover as it has shown a tendency to over race in previous starts. He added he restrained his mount through the early stages in the hope of obtaining a position with cover, however he was unable to achieve this as the mare continued to race too fiercely and as a result he was obliged to race wide without cover throughout the event. Rider reminded to ride all mounts out to line.

A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Reared as the start was effected and lost considerable ground (8L) and then was eased down by its rider.  When questioned, rider Declan Bates explained that after the mare reared, it then did not feel comfortable in its action and as he felt there may be something amiss, he eased Champagne Jenni down.  Trainer Lucy Yeomans was notified Champagne Jenni will be required to compete in a jump-out to the satisfaction of Stewards before being permitted to race again.  A post-race veterinary examination did not reveal any significant findings.
